verses.text: Ha t'a yik schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, ayik toxo ix tz'ib'chaj yuj winhaj Baruc yuninal winhaj Nerías tas ix wal Jeremías in tik schekab' in Dios, hata' ix wal t'a winhaj Baruc chi':

Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alan t'ayach icha tik: Ach Baruc, wan halan icha tik: Ob'iltak in. Anhej yahelal yet' ilk'olal syak' Jehová t'ayin. Wanxo in k'unb'i wok'i, maxtzak yal wik'an wip swab'i, xa chi.
Ina a in Jehová in, tzin satel tas ix in b'o'o, wan in tok'ank'eta tas ix wawej t'a masanil jun nación tik.

¿Tom smoj tza k'an tas tz'aj a k'echa'anh? Manhxo a k'ana', yujto ol wak'och yahelal t'a yib'anh masanil anima. Palta a in Jehová in swala', yalnhej b'aj ol ach k'ochok, manh ol ach in cha miljokchamok, xchi Jehová, xin chi t'a winh.
